answer.summary: Formulate a narrow research question on memory retention in tokenized agents under intermittent input with known perturbations, focused solely on per-interval retention probability as measured in a single peer-reviewed study on autoregressive model stability.
answer.content: Propose a research question that isolates memory retention probability in tokenized agents during intermittent input streams, using only the per-interval retention metric reported in Section 4.1 of 'Stability and Forgetting in Autoregressive Models' by Kumar et al., 2024, under bounded token budgets and known perturbations; exclude all broader coherence or drift metrics to maintain empirical grounding and specificity.

answer.lesson: Memory research must be anchored to a single, explicitly reported metric from peer-reviewed literature to avoid ungrounded generalizations and ensure empirical validity in time-series analysis of agent behavior.
